full_prompt_en: A square monochrome fashion photograph tightly frames a woman wearing large black sunglasses and an elaborate headpiece built from flowers and butterfly shapes. The background is a smooth mid-gray studio field, darker toward the upper corners and unbroken by furniture or setting. The woman's head and shoulders fill most of the image; her face turns slightly upward and toward the left, leaving a generous gray opening beside the right side of the silhouette. The glossy sunglasses sit broadly across the eyes, with thick dark frames and small white studio reflections on the lenses. Her nose and full lips emerge from a luminous pale face below the glasses, and the lips part very slightly. Around the hairline, a dense wreath of dark blooms, leaves, and many delicate butterfly wings expands past the top edge and out to both sides. Several wings show pale veining against dark outer rims, while smaller floral forms collect near the cheek and neck. Beneath the chin, a high black lace collar and heavily textured garment cover the throat and shoulders. A small bright floral ornament interrupts the dark collar near the center. The lower portion becomes almost black, with raised lace and clustered decoration appearing only where they catch a narrow highlight. The hard glassy surface of the eyewear contrasts with the fine, porous detail of wings and lace and with the smooth skin of the face. Strong studio light from the upper left brightens the cheek, bridge of the nose, lips, and selected wings, while deep black shadows preserve the headpiece's layered depth. The overall composition is theatrical and controlled, balancing a luminous, upward-facing face against dense decorative darkness and simple gray negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白时装摄影紧密地框住一位戴大型黑色墨镜的女子，头饰由花朵和蝴蝶形体层层组成。背景是平滑的中灰色影棚场域，向上方两角略暗，没有家具或具体场所打断。女子的头和肩占据画面大部；脸略向上、向左转，在剪影右边留下较宽的灰色空隙。光亮的墨镜横过双眼，镜框厚而深，镜片上有小小的白色影棚反光。鼻子和丰满嘴唇从镜下发亮的浅色面孔里浮现，嘴唇微微分开。发际周围，深色花朵、叶片和大量轻薄蝴蝶翅膀组成密集花冠，伸出上边缘及两侧。有些翅膀呈浅色脉络与深色边框，较小的花形聚在面颊和颈旁。下巴以下，高立的黑蕾丝衣领与厚重有肌理的衣物遮住喉部和双肩。中央附近一朵小亮花打断深色衣领。下部近乎纯黑，凸起的蕾丝与成簇装饰只在抓到狭窄亮光时出现。眼镜坚硬光滑的表面与翅膀、蕾丝细密多孔的细节以及平滑肤面形成对照。强烈影棚光从左上方照亮面颊、鼻梁、嘴唇和部分翅膀，深黑阴影则保留头饰的层叠纵深。整体构图戏剧性强却受控制，让发亮上仰的面孔与密集装饰暗部、简洁灰色留白相平衡。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome studio photography uses a disciplined range from smooth silver gray to dense black, punctuated by small, crisp white reflections. One broad softly modeled area carries the visual focus, while intricate near-black textures build a layered perimeter. Glossy hard edges sit beside porous, delicate detail, making material contrast as important as tonal contrast. The surrounding field stays plain and evenly graded so the central mass can grow complex without losing its silhouette. Light from one upper side shapes a clean pale volume and skims selected raised details; recessed regions remain almost fully black. The crop is close, with asymmetrical negative space relieving the decorative density. The overall finish is editorial, graphic, and theatrical, combining sharp accents with deep velvety shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白影棚摄影采用从平滑银灰到浓黑的严格灰阶范围，少量清脆白色反光穿插其中。一块宽阔而柔和塑形的区域承担视觉焦点，繁复近黑色肌理则建立层叠的外圈。光滑坚硬的边缘与多孔、轻薄细节相邻，使材料反差与明暗反差同样重要。周围色域保持素净、均匀渐变，让中央色块可以复杂而不失剪影。来自上方一侧的光塑造干净浅色体积，掠过部分凸起细节；凹入处则几乎全黑。裁切贴近，非对称留白缓解装饰密度。整体完成面具有编辑摄影感、图形感和戏剧性，把清锐亮点与天鹅绒般深影结合起来。
theme_en: A woman in dark sunglasses and an elaborate butterfly-and-flower headpiece
theme_zh: 一位女子戴深色墨镜和由蝴蝶与花朵组成的华丽头饰
name: Rankin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
